levels.title: Search Heist
levels.brief: Slip into the vault and reach the target room. At every room compare the target key with the room's key: smaller means go left, larger means go right. Every room you enter raises the alarm, so do not wander.

levels.title: Stash Loot
levels.brief: You are carrying a new treasure. Walk down the tree choosing left or right until you reach the empty spot where it belongs, and the new room will appear there. Duplicates are never allowed in a BST.

levels.title: Steal and Collapse
levels.brief: Steal treasures and the rooms collapse. For each target, decide which case applies: a leaf, one child, or two children. With two children the inorder successor (smallest key on the right) takes its place.

levels.title: Range Raid
levels.brief: Collect every treasure whose key lies in the range [lo, hi]. Click rooms next to ones you already entered. Rooms that cannot hold keys in the range turn grey: a smart thief never enters them.

levels.title: Boss: The Lazy Architect
levels.brief: The architect receives deliveries in sorted order, so the vault becomes a corridor. Find the last treasure before the alarm capacity shrinks away. Afterwards you will see why balancing matters.

levels.title: Read the Badges
levels.brief: Every room wears a balance badge: green means balance 0, yellow means +1 or -1, red means the room is unbalanced (balance of 2 or more either way). Click every unbalanced room. A balanced room clicked by mistake costs you.

levels.title: Single Rotations
levels.brief: A new room broke the balance. Find the lowest unbalanced room, select it, then rotate. Left-heavy in a straight line (LL) needs a right rotation; right-heavy in a straight line (RR) needs a left rotation. Wrong rotations cost +2 alarm and -50 points.

levels.title: Double Rotations
levels.brief: Zig-zag imbalance. First identify the case (LR or RL), then perform two rotations: the child first, then the unbalanced room. LR: rotate the left child left, then the room right. RL: the mirror image.

levels.title: Auto Mode and Prediction
levels.brief: The vault now repairs itself. Before each insert, predict which rotation (if any) will happen: none, LL, RR, LR or RL. Then watch the repair. A wrong prediction costs +2 alarm and -50 points.

levels.title: Boss: Order-Statistic Heist
levels.brief: Sorted deliveries arrive again, but this vault balances itself and every room knows its subtree size. Steal the k-th most valuable treasure (k-th largest) in O(log n) steps by using the sizes. The boss checks every size after the rotations.

levels.title: Endless Survival
levels.brief: Inserts and deletes stream in and nothing rebalances itself. Select a room and rotate to repair damage. One insert can unbalance several rooms but a single rotation can repair them. If any room reaches balance 3 (two hits before you repair), the vault collapses. Your score is how long you survive.
